posts.title: Why the wait?
posts.description: Rust just joined npm, pnpm, Yarn, Bun, uv, pip and Dependabot in supporting dependency cooldowns. Most malicious packages are pulled within hours, so waiting a few days is one of the cheapest supply-chain defenses there is. Here's how I set it up, and where it falls short.

posts.title: Treating AI like a ghostwriter
posts.description: Executives who criticize AI content may already be publishing AI-assisted text, because their ghostwriter used it. The question isn't who typed the words but whether a named person owns, reviews, and stands behind them.

posts.title: A leadership failure in disguise
posts.description: Qualcomm cut over 1,000 roles in India and called it a "performance-focused reduction." One engineer rated 3/4/4 and expecting a promotion was let go. Here's why the label matters, and what it actually signals about leadership.
